narrative.overview: A cool nocturnal tavern frames an open playing table with warm brass accents. Large original illustrations carry each card's identity, while separate painted brass frames and dark lower panels protect live names, rules and stats. The player hero sits beside the board, leaving the middle available for three crew places per side and brief public-event reactions.
keyCharacteristics: Fullscreen painted environment with a separate portrait composition.
Frameless source illustration and separate painted frames under semantic HTML card information.
Restrained brass, warm ivory and cool readiness cues.
Brief 2.5D legendary cutouts anchored to actual public crew plays.

midnightBrawl.implementationBoundary: Current legends are moving 2.5D cutouts, without articulation, rigging or video. An aiming-tether prototype was concurrently integrated into gestures and HTML; this documentation pass did not verify its visual quality. Advanced GPU targeting/ribbon quality targets and optional signature videos remain planned in BRAWL_CINEMATIC_PLAN.md.
midnightBrawl.lifecycle: Skip hidden-document starts; cancel on blur, resize, visibility change, page exit and shared effect lifecycle; reset hover.
midnightBrawl.validation: 226 npm tests passed; 49 rules-window cards; six viewports 1440×900/1920×1080/1280×720/390×844/320×568/844×390; real power and End turn actions, three power icons, 3/8 energy passed. Independent scoped review returned ship; settled 700ms capture verified 3 lit / 5 spent / 2 locked sockets against 3 / 8. No material fixes remained in the requested component scope. Evidence controls-v2/final. Local component refinement, no renewed whole-composition gate pass claim.
midnightBrawl.runtime: Fullscreen, local npm run dev at http://localhost:5173. No hosting.
midnightBrawl.typography: 400 local DM Serif Display names/wordmark/End turn; Brawl/Cinzel stats/cost/count; midnight-typography.js balances DM rules using measured 750 keyword and 500 body weights within the 74.5–94% recess.
midnightBrawl.paintedFrames: 104% overscan at -2%/-1%; art/reflection window 3%/3%, 94%×61.8%; no full rectangle underlay; selection/focus follow frame alpha. Live cost/stats use shared painted sockets.
midnightBrawl.utilityIcons: Inline SVG Menu/History/Rules icons: actual CSS 23px desktop, 17px portrait and short landscape; primary functional/state labels have 11px minimum final overrides.
midnightBrawl.legendTitleClearance: Title top bounded by actual hand top minus 74px; browser assertion prevents caption/hand collision.

narrative.overview:
Mode: **Operate**. This code-led game fills the PC and mobile viewport with a living fantasy playfield: carved walnut and bronze surround warm sandstone, with a forge at the left and a teal arcane lantern at the right. The readable central hearth carries the real cards and accumulates ash, hairline cracks and scorch marks as piles burn. Dark timber seat and bankroll panels keep information grounded in the painted world.

`dist/living-board.css`, loaded after `dist/online.css`, is the authoritative local gameplay material layer; `dist/living-board.js` supplies damage and reactions. Original generated desktop and portrait board images establish the environment. Existing local menus, online club, deck artwork and game rules keep their own implementations. Later historical sections below document those surfaces and earlier refinements; this overview and the Ember Hearth guidance take precedence for the active local board.
keyCharacteristics: Carved walnut and bronze framing a warm sandstone playfield.
A fullscreen playable table with persistent, deal-specific burn damage.
Ivory and gold information on dark timber panels.
Fire, dust, frost, wind and teal arcane reactions tied to actual play.

rules.name: Viewport ownership
rules.body: The game owns 100dvh; the shell is full-bleed and square.

rules.name: Visible state
rules.body: Selection, keyboard focus and turn ownership retain distinct written and visual signals.

dos: **Do** keep the actual deal and next action central to the viewport.
**Do** use existing local card, board and font assets, preserving credits and license links.
**Do** keep selection, focus, turn ownership and written status distinct.
**Do** preserve horizontal scrolling within crowded hands and safe-area padding.
**Do** disable animations and transitions under system or saved reduced-motion preferences.
**Do** retain seeded damage with its saved deal and clear it for a fresh deal.
donts: **Don't** reintroduce the hidden landing-page hero as the main game composition.
**Don't** give the full-viewport shell the older 18px rounded-container styling.
**Don't** expose hidden opponent cards or replace recognizable suit/rank artwork with decorative abstractions.
**Don't** assume a paper background behind gameplay controls; paper is the dialog context.
**Don't** restore felt over the active Ember Hearth board or burn the card artwork itself.
